tasks.description:
🟡 #43 · Non-tester people are named in this public repo: remove them too?

Coral's rec: Third pass, once, after you've marked the list. Section A (private people and a client) I'd remove. Section B (details about you) is yours to judge. Say yes to the calendar match if you want the strongest check against a fourth pass. One mail filename would change, so Pard would hear first. A third pass would leave a new set of old commits, so it would need one more request to GitHub afterwards.

tasks.title: In the Todoist model, does your deck follow the list's order, or keep its own?
tasks.description:
🟡 #40 · Agent's deck: does the deck follow the list's order, or keep its own?

Coral's rec: Keep its own. The top card is what the app protects, and "Later" has to mean something. New tasks would join behind the top card, as Siri's do. Two smaller questions are in the write-up (answering from a card; whether this replaces R4.1 and R4.3).
